acceptanceCriteria: A conversation language supplied by the adapter is used for the full Outcome body, archive delivery segments, and assistant message events.
CLI and MCP expose the same bounded language values and deterministic fallback; explicit conversation language wins over process locale.
English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese regression tests prove required human sections remain localized while Contract acceptance text remains unchanged.
Delivery identity binds the selected language and retries do not regenerate a different-language body.
Language-only presentation changes do not start verification, archive, or host delivery processes beyond the requested operation.
goal: Archive delivery and human Outcome rendering use the conversation language for English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese without translating Contract facts.
intent: Make archived Outcome language follow the active conversation language through one explicit, deterministic interface.
outOfScope: host-specific native chat APIs and display confirmation
sources: User requirement: Outcome language follows the conversation language.
Existing MCP language parameter and CLI AI_COCKPIT_LANGUAGE fallback.
